title: Independent CSV identifier practice
instructions: Create independent_submission.py with a function named load_players(csv_text). Accept CSV text and return a pandas DataFrame. Preserve player_id values as strings with leading zeros and keep fps numeric. Attempt it yourself; record any assistance honestly. This task does not establish independent ability until a submission and its assistance are reviewed.
